 WIT , US97651M1099 Wipro stock: MarketWatch cites 41 ratings and a USD 1.84 target
 Published on 10/20/2026 at 15:18 | Editorial responsibility: Rafael Müller, Editor-in-Chief AD HOC NEWS 
 Q2 operating margin reached 16.5 percent on October 15, 2026. Wipro stock costs EUR 1.74 on October 20, 2026 at 3:09 p.m. CEST. 
 Analyst consensus remains Hold
 MarketWatch listed 41 ratings and an average target of USD 1.84 on October 19, 2026.
 Wipro's second-quarter operating margin reached 16.5 percent on October 15, 2026.
 Wipro stock costs EUR 1.74 at Lang & Schwarz on October 20, 2026 at 3:09 p.m. CEST, 43.69 percent below its 52-week high.
 Wipro is expected to report third-quarter results on January 14, 2027.
 WIT, US97651M1099, Illustration mit AI erstellt. 
 Wipro Limited (ISIN US97651M1099) had an average analyst target of USD 1.84 across 41 ratings in the October 19, 2026 snapshot from MarketWatch . The consensus recommendation was Hold, while Wipro stock stood at EUR 1.74 at Lang & Schwarz on October 20, 2026 at 3:09 p.m. CEST.
 Margin reached 16.5 percent
 Wipro's second-quarter IT services revenue rose 0.6 percent year over year in constant currency to USD 2.61 billion, while sequential revenue was flat, MarketBeat reported on October 15, 2026. Operating margin improved to 16.5 percent, but adjusted earnings per share of USD 0.03 missed the USD 0.04 consensus.
 Stock remains below its yearly high
 The Lang & Schwarz price of EUR 1.74 is 43.69 percent below Wipro's 52-week high of USD 3.09 and 9.43 percent above its 52-week low of USD 1.59. The currency difference prevents a direct euro-to-dollar range calculation, so the high and low are presented as the primary-exchange values rather than combined with the euro quote.
 January 14 is the next date
 Earnings Whispers expects Wipro to report third-quarter results on January 14, 2027, before the market opens. Wipro's investor page identifies the second-quarter reporting period as the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with results announced on October 15, 2026.
 At the primary listing, Wipro last traded at USD 1.93 on the NYSE on October 19, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET. Its market capitalization was USD 19.1 billion, with a price-to-earnings ratio of 14.31 and volume of 10,241,974 shares at that timestamp.
 What the target means for valuation
 The USD 1.84 average target sits 4.66 percent below the USD 1.93 NYSE price, a modest gap that contrasts with the much wider distance to the 52-week high. The next report will put the current margin and the mixed revenue trend back at the center of the valuation discussion.
 Wipro price and investor calendar
 Wipro stock was trading at EUR 1.74 at Lang & Schwarz on October 20, 2026 at 3:09 p.m. CEST. The further course of trading is shown by the continuously updated real-time quote of Wipro stock .
